data.name: DoItWithPassion
data.value: We love what we do and we do it with passion!

data.name: DoItWithPassionContent
data.value:
At Emdad Company, we recognize the importance of innovation and technology in driving progress. Therefore, we allocate a significant portion of our resources to research and development, working to introduce new and advanced technologies that enhance our performance and provide effective solutions for our clients.
By leveraging modern technologies such as artificial intelligence, 3D printing, and smart systems, we ensure the delivery of high-quality products that meet the needs of all the sectors we serve.
Emdad is considered one of the leading companies in defense technology, providing the latest military devices and equipment characterized by efficiency and reliability. The company also offers comprehensive petroleum logistics solutions, including fuel pumps, occupational safety and health equipment, fire trucks and firefighting tools, water treatment and industrial wastewater treatment units, tanker trucks for petroleum transport, and industrial furnace igniters with various capacities.
Emdad adopts the latest technologies across all its fields — from advanced military technology to petroleum applications and logistics services. We are committed to delivering integrated and distinguished solutions that contribute to achieving safety and security while meeting the growing market demands in defense, industry, and petroleum logistics services.

data.value: The company was established to operate in petroleum materials, the needs and supplies of petroleum companies, and projects related to petroleum companies.

data.name: WhatMakesUsStandOutContent2.1
data.value: The company provides petroleum materials required by petroleum companies owned by the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum, including crude oil, gas, marine diesel, and more........

data.name: WhatMakesUsStandOutContent2.2
data.value: The company operates in supplying and providing all equipment and requirements for petroleum companies, including fuel pumps, occupational health and safety equipment, firefighting vehicles and all firefighting systems required by petroleum companies, water purification and treatment units, industrial wastewater treatment systems, tanker trucks for transporting petroleum products, industrial furnace igniters with different capacities, security surveillance systems and their dedicated cameras, low-current network equipment including computer networks, alarm systems and related systems, all types of machinery spare parts (based on drawings and reverse engineering) through the Digital Manufacturing Center (DMC), as well as overhauls, maintenance, and balancing of mechanical and rotating parts required by petroleum companies, petroleum gas analysis laboratory supplies, various oils, greases, and vehicle filters, metal drilling machines, CNC machines, electric welding wires and welding machines, fans, printer drums and laser toners, and all other requirements of petroleum companies. The company also supplies medical products including biometric fingerprint devices, capillary therapy devices, blood analysis devices, and measuring equipment required by hospitals affiliated with petroleum companies, in addition to providing office and hotel furniture and fittings, computer equipment including desktops, laptops, tablets, and television screens of various sizes required by offices affiliated with petroleum companies.
